{{Quote|We found it, Mother. Here is the orb you requested.|This Nightsister brings the orb containing Dooku's lock of hair|<ref name="Massacre" />}}
A [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] '''[[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]]''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] and participated in the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle of Dathomir]] against the [[Droid Army|droid army]] led by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Supreme Commander]] [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|battle of Dathomir]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], this Nightsister along with a fellow one were sent by [[Talzin/Legends|Mother Talzin]] to recover an orb containing a lock of hair [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] so she could use it to create a magical voodoo figurine likeness of Dooku, conducting her magic through it to torment the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] into rescinding his attack or else suffering an agonizing death. The Nightsisters succeeded in doing so, but General Grievous was then informed by Dooku to forget about [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and focus on Mother Talzin, so he attacked the Nightsisters fortress directly, killing [[Daka/Legends|Old Daka]] and this Nightsister, but failing to kill Talzin who managed to escape.<ref name="Massacre" />
